feature: Prepare private water phases only for animated query frames
status: Accepted source change. Mean-only consumers avoid phase work; normal animated contact preparation stays at frame start. Existing private runtimes reused, with no new export, APK or delivery archive.

implementation.change: Initialize the private phase array empty. The first begin_frame with actual deformation enabled fills it using the unchanged deterministic phase_grid. An implicit first posed query without begin_frame also initializes it safely. Mean queries and waves-disabled frames never allocate phases.
implementation.timing_contract: WaterInteraction already constructs Surface and immediately begins a deformed query frame in the same step, so normal animated preparation is not moved to a later first-contact query. A consumer switching from mean-only to deformed frames pays one preparation then. Already prepared phases survive clear, as before.
implementation.memory: An unused/mean-only Surface no longer allocates 1089 float32 values (4356 bytes). A posed Surface still owns its own 4356-byte array. No new shared cache or GPU resource. Existing bounded triangle cache is unchanged.
implementation.unchanged: Phase-grid algorithm and seed, local random state, water-clock arithmetic, geometry/triangles, navigation, solver and worker lifecycle, shaders, graphics presets, cloud switches, protocol and .8/.9 fixes.

cost.scope: CPU time, not GPU time, whole-game FPS, map-load time or complete water-level callback. Constructor tests use 12 ABBA batches per map; constructor-plus-first-posed uses six. Two fresh-process ABBA domain runs per platform include constructor work. No other desktop engine overlaps the reported timing runs.

platforms.android: Retroid Pocket 5, Android 33, Adreno 650, existing private Compatibility runtime
platforms.desktop: Linux AMD Ryzen 5950X, headless CPU; separate GPU oracle uses RTX3090 Ti

cost.interpretation: Android mean-surface construction removes about 6 ms; actual fresh domain construction improves 10-12% across three maps. Constructor-plus-first-posed work remains approximately unchanged. No cached/moving domain improvement is claimed.

correctness.phase: 312/0 on Android and Linux: exact 1089 phase floats, initial absence, mean-only and waves-disabled frames, deformed-frame preparation before queries, explicit and implicit first use, clock/offset changes, retention through clear, no regeneration, independent ownership and unchanged navigation. A further 312/0 checks the canonical eager reference against the full new Surface.
correctness.surface: 346/0 each on Android and Linux, retaining mixed owners, slivers, boundary tolerances, transforms, live lava flags, mesh replacement/removal, LRU and clear cases.
correctness.domain: 1961/0 per base run across zones 1/11/8 and 1900/0 in LiA zones 1/10/26. Includes exact domain/cache/invalidation keys plus an assertion in every candidate domain that its phase array stays empty.
correctness.lifetime: 31/0 Linux, 31/0 Android native, 31/0 Android scalar worker. Worker is active on clear and joined safely.
correctness.gpu_oracle: 28/0 per arm across Linux Compatibility, Android Compatibility and Android Mobile. Four modes: base, changed wave clock, waves off, offsets/re-enabled waves. Zero quantized height-error channel, no coverage holes/missing samples, and at least 4077/4096 heights change with the explicit wave clock. All 12 baseline/candidate 4096-height arrays and 12 CPU/GPU agreement images match exactly. These are error/coverage images, not whole-scene appearance captures.

fixture_strengthening.change: The original GPU oracle did not require positive wave motion or explicitly hold its whole test clock. It now enables the geometric-wave control, asserts a positive height change, stops terrain processing after tree attachment, holds Engine.time_scale, checks clock retention during captures and records SHA-256 of all 4096 expected height floats.
fixture_strengthening.intermediate_evidence: The unheld positive-motion Android Compatibility runs sampled 4078 versus 4087 changed heights while each still agreed with its own GPU state; this was insufficient for a cross-run geometry comparison. Final held runs agree in state, height bytes and oracle images. Earlier passing runs remain in raw evidence.

intermediate_prototype.result: Numerically passing first-vertex-only preparation. Replaced by frame-start preparation plus implicit-query fallback to retain the existing normal contact timing boundary.

runtime_scope.scripts: Complete baseline and candidate Surface scripts, including their property initializers and constructors, are loaded directly. Full Field scripts differ only by their redirected Surface preload. No typed method-only constructor adapter is used.
runtime_scope.android: Existing org.cursedlands.performance app. Only domain/lifetime tests load the previously qualified two-class native-water adapter; direct phase/surface/GPU tests require no added native classes. No engine, pack or installed helper is replaced.
runtime_scope.limits: This is complete-script substitution inside older private runtimes, not a new complete-current-source package. Original RMX3890/Adreno610 and RTX3050 report causes, Windows/device acceptance and the separate Adreno650 Mobile cloud/material-water flicker remain open.
runtime_scope.correctness_only_overlap: An unrelated headless Godot process overlaps LiA, Linux lifetime and one early image run. Their results are used for correctness only; all reported CPU timing runs and final GPU pairs have independent run records.

next_work: Fresh domain work remains about 47-54 ms on these Android maps. Profile remaining static triangle indexing/query work and positive-waterfall/level-change geometry for the next substantial cost reduction. Keep the separate unresolved Mobile lighting diagnosis and original device reports open. No playthroughs or unsolicited packages.
